column2: Retain Azarias son of Oded and the Spirit of the Lord coming upon him. The explicit divine relation supports the inherited capitalization here; no different prophet name is substituted from verse 8.
Retain the meeting with Asa and all Judah and Benjamin, reciprocal presence and the paired seek/forsake outcomes. Ordinary you addresses the king and people, not God.

Retain many days, Israel without a true God, a guiding priest or law. The nominal Greek leaves tense unexpressed; inherited is does not establish whether the speech describes past, present or future history.
column3: The temporal setting of this nominal clause remains open alongside the following explicit futures.

column2: Retain future return to the Lord and His being found. They represents collective Israel despite the selected singular return verb; no distress-and-seeking narrative is imported into this short clause.
Retain present no peace for outgoing or incoming persons and terror from the Lord upon all inhabitants. The selected divine source of terror is not omitted.
Retain future nation/city warfare and God's past terrifying them in every affliction. Do not regularize all verbs to one tense to create a simpler historical account.
Retain the strengthening command, hands not growing feeble and reward for work. The bodily image and rationale remain together.

Retain Adad the prophet, the unnamed hearer growing strong, removal of abominations across the named territories and renewal of the altar. Do not change Adad to Oded or Azarias merely to match verse 1.
column3: The relation among the prophet names remains unresolved; the hearer is contextually Asa but is not newly named in the reading.

column2: Retain Judah and Benjamin and resident outsiders from Ephraim, Manasse and Symeon, with many Israelites joining because of divine presence. Outsider status is contextual residence, not a claim that these tribal migrants are ethnically non-Israelite.

Retain singular he sacrificing from spoil they brought, with 700 calves and 7,000 sheep. The singular sacrificial agent and plural suppliers remain distinct.
Retain singular he entering the covenant, ancestral God and all heart and soul. Do not change the selected singular verb to they solely because the following oath is collective.
column3: Passed into is a provisional covenant idiom; the singular agent's relation to communal participation merits review.

column2: Retain death for failure to seek God across younger/older and male/female. No execution method or specific enforcement episode is added to the reported rule.
Retain swearing by the Lord, loud voice, trumpets and horn trumpets. Both instrument categories remain rather than being reduced to one.

Retain collective rejoicing over the oath, all soul, every desire, God's being found and rest all around. The repeated seeking/finding relation fulfills the earlier speech without replacing its distinct tenses.

Retain Maacah as his mother, removal from ministering to Astarte and the idol cut and burned at Kedron. Do not substitute removal from queen-mother office or grandmother in place of the selected relationships and activity.
Retain high places still in Israel and Asa's complete heart throughout his days. Do not erase this qualification to reconcile the earlier removal account.

Retain David his father explicitly and the holy things of the Lord God's house, with silver, gold and vessels. No substitution of Asa's immediate father or own dedications repairs the selected wording.
Retain no war until Asa's thirty-fifth year. The numeral and scope remain without chronological harmonization to chapter 14 or Kings.
Retain Baasha's campaign in Asa's thirty-eighth year and fortified Rama blocking exit and entrance for Asa. Do not replace thirty-eight with thirty-six or a reconstructed earlier date.
Retain gold and silver from both treasuries, the son of Ader, Syria's king and Damascus. The inherited name expression is not silently converted into a single Ben-hadad proper name.
column3: The genitive royal title's attachment within son of Ader, king of Syria requires grammatical and onomastic review; the English comma does not conclusively identify the titled individual.

column2: Retain the imperative to make a covenant, both fathers in its scope, the sent metals and Baasha driven away. Do not replace the selected covenant request with an assertion that a treaty already exists or insert an explicit break-your-treaty clause.
Retain the son of Ader listening, commanders dispatched and strikes on Ion, Dan, Abelmain and all surrounding Naphtali districts. No store-city category is imported.
Retain hearing, cessation of further Rama construction and stopping the work. The repetition emphasizes the result rather than narrating a second project.
Retain taking all Judah and Rama's building materials and reuse at Gabae and Maspha. No exemption clause from Kings is added to the labor summons.
Retain Anani as prophet, Asa's misplaced trust and Syria's force saved from his hand. Do not replace Syria with Israel to make the political outcome more intuitive.
Retain Ethiopians and Libyans, great force, confidence and numerous horsemen, and the Lord's delivery because of trust. The selected confidence term is not silently emended into chariots.
column3: The relation of confidence to force and horsemen remains a difficult construction requiring review.

column2: Retain the Lord's eyes throughout the earth, strength with the whole heart, acted ignorantly and ensuing war. The selected ignorance expression is not automatically strengthened to moral foolishness.
column3: Whether the strengthening concerns people with complete hearts or action within such hearts remains syntactically open in the inherited formulation.

column2: Retain anger at the prophet, imprisonment, repeated anger explanation and maltreatment among the people. No named prison device or torture method is supplied.
Retain behold and first/last deeds in the kings book of Judah and Israel. The record notice does not identify a specific surviving edition of that source.

Retain illness in the feet in year thirty-nine, growing severity and seeking physicians instead of the Lord. This remains a report of Asa's conduct, not an added general instruction against medical treatment.
Retain sleep with fathers and death in the same selected thirty-ninth year. Do not replace it with forty-one or invent an intervening two-year interval.
